conflicts.permit: We may share information about you with service providers who perform services on our behalf.
conflicts.prohibit: None of the data collected by us is shared with 3rd parties, business partners or even advertisers.
conflicts.situation: Sharing user data collected by the app with third-party service providers (such as analytics platforms or payment providers).
conflicts.reason: The policy makes an absolute claim that none of the collected data is shared with third parties, but immediately lists third parties it shares information with.
